newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Merger Dutch De Boer, Unigro advances.
newsitem.headline: Merger Dutch De Boer, Unigro advances.

text.p: Supermarkets group De Boer Winkelbedrijven NV said on Monday, the proposed merger with wholesale retailer Unigro was well underway.
The proposed merger, to be approved on the general shareholders meeting of May 28, will be effective as of January one, 1997, both companies said in a statement.
The integration process will lead to a reduction of 250 to 300 in the number of jobs, the companies said.
The number of distribution centre will be reduced to four or five from the current nine centres.
More details on the merger will be given at the release of the two parties' annual reports on May 13, the statement said.
